transformation: The machine-readable source that produced the verified published PDF is frozen in source/paper.json. All ordered paragraphs, title emphasis, citations, disclosure, references and URL targets are conserved. Repository framing, scholarly metadata and bibliography normalization are separate. The PDF is mirrored byte-for-byte.
validation_status: Validation is reproducible through the packaged complete-text, metadata, bibliography, immutable-PDF and mutation checks. Exact release results are preserved in the canonical working records.
retrieval_history: Authority retrieval history is preserved in private working records. Public field provenance identifies responsible publication registries; no reader access dates are added.
